request.query: Two polynomials with equal remainders modulo a polynomial have equal evaluations at any root over a commutative ring

items.name: IsAdjoinRootMonic.map_modByMonic
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring S] {f : Polynomial R} [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  (h : IsAdjoinRootMonic S f) (g : Polynomial R), h.map (g %ₘ f) = h.map g

items.name: Polynomial.eval₂_modByMonic_eq_self_of_root
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] {f : R →+* S} {p q : Polynomial R},
  q.Monic → ∀ {x : S}, Polynomial.eval₂ f x q = 0 → Polynomial.eval₂ f x (p %ₘ q) = Polynomial.eval₂ f x p

items.name: Polynomial.aeval_modByMonic_eq_self_of_root
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {p q : Polynomial R},
  q.Monic → ∀ {x : S}, (Polynomial.aeval x) q = 0 → (Polynomial.aeval x) (p %ₘ q) = (Polynomial.aeval x) p

items.name: SModEq.eval
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_6} [inst : CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {x y : R},
  x ≡ y [SMOD I] → ∀ (f : Polynomial R), Polynomial.eval x f ≡ Polynomial.eval y f [SMOD I]

items.name: Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_of_dvd_sub
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {p₁ p₂ q : Polynomial R}, q.Monic → q ∣ p₁ - p₂ → p₁ %ₘ q = p₂ %ₘ q

items.name: Polynomial.modByMonic_X_sub_C_eq_C_eval
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] (p : Polynomial R) (a : R),
  p %ₘ (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) = Polynomial.C (Polynomial.eval a p)
